rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
Loremaster"Yataa'Halli, the time has come to follow the course prescribed to us by Wotan. Ragnarok may be upon us if we do not strengthen our bond with the realm of the Gods. Enough of war!"
Yataa'Halli"Yes, I see that the dwarves have lived too much in this world... But, such was the nature of the times. Now peace will reign. Let us start! To the ceremonial grounds!"
Spearman"Hold there! We are trying to ambush the Dreadwyrm while it is out of its lair! Hold still. If it sees us, we shall all surely perish!"

Peasant 
"Oh, it's too late, catching the monster unawares was our only chance! Run for your lives!"

Spearman"The city of Spriggan thanks you. This monster has been stalking our villagers! It arrived one day last season and burrowed out a hideous lair in the earth. Since that time it has feasted upon our citizens."
Spearman"Take this talisman as thanks. Save it to call upon an Angel when you are in an impossible situation..."
Loremaster"Wotan's Chant is being cast here... who has the power to summon the aid of Wotan?"
Dwarf"Look here! Three stones of different colors... all engraved with runic symbols. The magic of Wotan has been modified by a cunning adept."

Man at Arms"A herd of Centaurs came and blocked this pass with magical ceremony. They were not the noble creatures that we are accustomed to... an evil light glowed in their eyes. They held aloft gems that glowed with power."
Man at Arms"We need to free this route so to see our mage thorvald!"
Loremaster"The 12 runes are placed according to the ancient customs... Novice Ironhill!!! Produce the prayers for Wotan that we prepared. We all hope these rites restore our God's strength!"
Valkyrie"You have surmounted much, Dwarves! Many factions tried to steal the blessings of Wotan."
Loremaster"We slay the centaurs you spoke of... And they held these 3 gems."
Tenderfoot"Loremaster! The gems are pulsating with power... I cannot hold them any longer!"
Man at Arms"The mountain is cleared, just as quickly as it was created... in a flash of light! Dwarves, we owe you this as thanks for clearing the way to our wise mage Thorvald."

Mage Hugin"Oh no you don't!!! I have watched you gather the Runes together, all the while foreseeing the moment when their power will be mine. Now, the time has come for you to fall, and I to seize the Runes power!"
Loremaster"The ceremony can start! To the ceremonial grounds."

Valkyrie  
"The link between this world and Wotan's realm has been restored!"
Valkyrie"The future is still uncertain. But with Wotan's aid, the Dwarves have a chance to prosper once more..."
Dwarf"We have defeated the Barbarian city Otzwall! We can be sure that they have hoarded away the spoils of many raids."
Engineer"There are still factions not loyal to the Emperor. Demosthene will be pleased that Rotturdam has been recaptured!"
Proud Dwarf"I have never in my life seen a Greenskin city so sumptuous! This must be from where the greenskin leader rules his squalid empire."
King's Guard"A wand! What powers can be summoned with this instrument, Loremaster?"
Dwarf"I wager the Barbarians were planning a raid on Sallat's shop..."
Loremaster"What curious symbols adorn this shrine. The Orcs have invented a system of magic all their own!"
Loremaster"Enough of conquest! We have been sidetracked long enough... Let us make haste towards the ceremonial grounds. Wotan awaits!"

I have potent spells at a reasonable price.

My spells are the most potent in the region.

"Just as I thought... The Mage Hugin has been gathering knowledge of the runes for some time!"
